shared_elements: boats/ships shown in profile with upturned prows and crew strokes
multiple small motifs scattered over a rock surface without frame or ground line
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive repertoire: profile ships with curved, upturned prows and a row of short vertical crew strokes above the hull, accompanied by stick-like human figures, profile quadrupeds and isolated cup-mark discs, all scattered across an open surface with no frame or baseline and rendered in the same flat, silhouetted, highly schematic manner. The main differences are in emphasis and detail — A packs its figures into a dense vertical column with ladder-like and lattice motifs, while B spreads a few isolated groups (including a line of armed figures) across a wide open field.
